nom: Bioderma Sensibio Micellar Cleansing Oil Face Cleanser for Sensitive Skin

segments.oily: Reports from oily-skin reviewers are mixed: some say it didn't make their skin feel oily and needed no follow-up cleanser, while others found it left a residual oily or shiny feel and still prefer to double cleanse.
segments.combination: The combination-skin reviewers disagree: one found it too oily for her skin, while another with oily/combination skin was pleasantly surprised that it needed no double cleanse.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including one with dry eczema-prone skin, generally report it hydrates well and helps with dryness, including around the eyes and on rough, clogged areas like the nose.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive skin is by far the most represented group, and most reviewers — including those with rosacea or eczema — report no stinging, redness or breakouts, describing it as calming and barrier-friendly; dissent is notable, though, with a few reviewers, including two critical reviews, reporting bad breakouts they trace to comedogenic ingredients despite the sensitive-skin marketing.
segments.normal: The one reviewer with normal skin mentions occasional breakouts in general but doesn't attribute them to the product.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say it doesn't cause breakouts, including several who are normally prone to reacting to oils; dissent is significant, though, with multiple reviewers — including two critical reviews — reporting new or worse breakouts, which some trace to comedogenic ingredients in the formula, and one reviewer who breaks out only when skipping the rinse step the instructions call optional.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including ones with rosacea, report no redness, stinging or irritation, and one specifically says her redness noticeably decreased after a few weeks of use.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe their skin barrier as calmer or healthier-feeling after switching to this cleanser, including one whose skin felt visibly less reactive.
concerns.oiliness: Opinions split on oiliness: several reviewers, including some with oily skin, say it doesn't leave any oily or greasy feeling and skips the need for a second cleanser, while others — including one with combination skin — find it leaves skin feeling a little too oily or shiny for their taste.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe it as hydrating rather than drying, leaving skin soft and comfortable rather than stripped or tight, including several with dry skin; no reviewer reports it leaving skin dry.

aspects.libelle: Doesn't remove all makeup in one pass, needs double cleansing
Emulsifies to a milky rinse with no greasy film
Economical, a little goes a long way
Pump can be hard to open or dispenses too forcefully
Bulky bottle, not ideal for travel

extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this cleansing oil because it is marketed for sensitive skin, but it immediately broke me out in areas that I haven't had acne in years. Unfortunately, the very first ingredient is comedogenic, which is surprising for a product aimed at people who are already dealing with reactive or acne prone skin. If you are acne prone or cautious about pore clogging ingredients, definitely check the ingredient list before purchasing.

I switched to this from Palmer's thinking it wouod be better for my skin since its unscented. Boy, was i wrong! After a couple of weeks I started to get the worst breakouts I've ever had in my life. After some process of elimination and research, turns out the first two ingredients have a moderate-to-high risk of being comedogenic (pore-clogging). So dont believe everything you see on the packagaing! I'm sure it's fine for some people, but definitely not suitable for sensitive skin.

This micellar cleansing oil did not irritate my skin, and the pump made it convenient to use. It was necessary to lather it up for makeup removal. It did not remove all of my makeup as effortlessly as I had hoped, including eye makeup. I had to use a second cleanser to remove all traces of makeup, and it seemed to take more rubbing on my face than I expected. I have combination skin, but this felt a bit too oily for my skin. I will continue to use it to help remove my eye makeup, but I would probably not repurchase when I run out. This cleansing oil was gifted to me in exchange for my honest review..

extraits.titre: Not the best not the worst
extraits.texte: Overall this product was pretty good, but I didn't get anything special out of it! If anything it irritated my skin, but I also have very sensitive skin. It does do what described though.

From the first use, it felt luxuriously smooth and removed every trace of makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime without any stinging or tightness. It melts away even stubborn mascara but still rinses off cleanly, leaving my skin soft, calm, and hydrated. It does not leave me feeling greasy. What makes this product special is its micellar-infused oil formula, which gives the deep-clean feel of a cleansing oil with the gentleness Sensibio is known for. My skin barrier feels happier, and redness has noticeably decreased after a few weeks of use. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it sometimes takes two rinses to remove heavier foundation. Still, those are small trade-offs for a cleanser that's this gentle and effective.

extraits.titre: Great on sensitive skin and if you have rosacea
extraits.texte: I have combination sensitive skin with rosacea. With the colder weather, my skin is now pretty dry. My derm suggested using this instead of washing my face in the morning which was flaring up my rosacea. I've been using it for about a week and I love it. It makes my face feel soft and luxurious. It hasn't flared up my rosaca and I haven't broken out. My skin feels a lot calmer and even though I'm patting it dry off my face, it feels like my skin has a barrier on it to protect it throughout the day.

extraits.titre: Works well to remove makeup and helps with dryness
extraits.texte: The cleansing oil works well to remove makeup and has a nice mild scent. While the instructions specify no washing is needed afterwards I have experienced some mild acne if I don't do so. Overall, it works well and helps with hydration for my skin, which tends to be dry.
